guards-inverses.evidence: Guard delta_t>0 enforced; rejection cases cover delta_t=0 (domain), delta_t=-3 (domain), missing delta_t (missing-input). Singular branches correct: 0/0 admits any positive duration, nonzero/0 has no finite duration, 0/nonzero gives delta_t=0 violating guard. No waveform/instantaneous reconstruction claimed. scope.evidence: Finite-interval average-current definition only. Assumptions require same cross section and interval, fixed orientation, full-window charge accounting; no constant-current assumption for the definition. Limitations exclude instantaneous/peak/RMS/heating/power, transient evolution, circuit solution, safety guidance; zero net does not imply zero dissipation. r2 changes only delta_t quantity_id elapsed_time->duration per brief; symbol/unit/context/expression/references/guards/sources unchanged. source-fidelity.evidence: Relationship I_avg=delta_Q/delta_t maps source Eq 9.1 I_ave=Delta Q/Delta t (verified live: average current is rate of charge flow past a location; Delta Q net charge through cross section in Delta t). Eq 9.2 1 A = 1 C/s and Eq 9.3 instantaneous limit dQ/dt correctly contrasted. Q is net transported charge, not stored charge. Example 9.1(a) values 720 C / 4.00 s = 180 A confirmed verbatim; part (b) Delta t=Delta Q/I supports inverse. Conventional-current direction paraphrase matches Current in a Circuit text.
